risks.risk: Wrong gearbox ratio/spec (speed reducer ratio, shaft size, mounting pattern) leading to incompatibility with the buyer’s motor/application.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate/label showing ratio (i), model/serial, input/output shaft sizes, and mounting dimensions (or a close-up of any stamped markings).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used speed reducer with unknown ratio/spec (worst-case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Internal damage or bearing wear not visible externally (may still look clean but fail under load).
risks.proof: Video clip of it running under load (or at least a bench run) showing smooth operation, plus a short sound recording to confirm 'no knock'.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven for smooth operation (worst-case: may have issues).

risks.risk: Oil leak / seal failure or incorrect oil level/contamination.
risks.proof: Photos of all seals and mating faces, and a close-up of the oil fill/drain area; also confirm oil type and level.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing service (worst-case: treat as may leak).

risks.risk: Missing or incorrect accessories (coupling, mounting bolts, vent/breather, output flange) affecting installation.
risks.proof: Photo of both input and output ends showing shaft/flange details, and what exactly is included in the package.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown inclusions (worst-case: buyer may need extra parts).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the nameplate/label (ratio i, model, serial number, input/output specs).
Send photos of both ends (input shaft and output shaft/flange) with measurements (shaft diameter, keyway, bolt pattern).
Provide a short running video (bench run) and/or sound recording to confirm 'no knock'.
Show oil fill/drain area and seals/mating faces to confirm no leaks and correct oil condition.
